name: Azariah
bio: Azariah son of Oded was a prophet moved by the Spirit of God to meet King Asa of Judah after his victory over Zerah the Cushite. He declared that the LORD would remain with Asa only as long as Asa sought him, recalling how Israel had once suffered great turmoil and warfare for going a long season without the true God, a teaching priest, or the law. Encouraged by this word, Asa pressed ahead with sweeping religious reforms across Judah and Benjamin (2 Chronicles 15:1-8).
